Supreme Court urges Manipur ethnic groups to restore peace, open highways

The Supreme Court of India urged the Kuki and Meitei groups in Manipur to work towards restoring peace and removing blockades on highways. Chief Justice of India Surya Kant stated that highways are essential lifelines for ordinary citizens. The court expressed a desire to avoid issuing sweeping directives that could destabilize the state further. The court's remarks were made in response to the ongoing ethnic conflict in Manipur.
